subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does a concrete ACP trace or test demonstrate tool execution before the current `requestPermission` flow returns its approval decision?
rationale: The current source contradicts the described asynchronous classifier flow, but only security-owner review of a concrete runtime reproduction can safely determine whether another approval boundary is vulnerable.

options.title: Request private reproduction
options.body: Ask for the ACP backend, exact tool call, permission options, token-limit configuration, timestamps, and a minimal failing trace or test before choosing a repair.

options.title: Close after security review
options.body: Close as unsupported if security review confirms there is no asynchronous classifier path and the reporter cannot demonstrate an approval bypass.
